title: Diploma and ITI
intro: Technical skills you can start after Class 8 or Class 10.

nodes.label: ITI trade (6 months to 2 years)
nodes.note: Electrician, fitter, welder, turner, COPA and more.

nodes.label: Diploma (3 years)
nodes.note: Mechanical, civil, electrical, electronics, computer science and more.

nodes.label: BE or BTech (join in 2nd year)
nodes.note: An engineering degree in 3 more years.

nodes.label: Technician or machine operator
nodes.note: Make and fix things in factories and workshops.

nodes.label: Apprentice in industry or railways
nodes.note: Learn on the job and get paid.

nodes.label: Workshop owner
nodes.note: Start your own workshop or service centre.

nodes.label: Junior engineer
nodes.note: Work in companies, railways and government departments.

nodes.label: Engineer
nodes.note: Work as an engineer after your degree.

nodes.label: Electrician
nodes.note: Wire homes and fix electrical faults.

nodes.label: Fitter
nodes.note: Assemble and repair machines.

nodes.label: Welder
nodes.note: Join metal parts safely.

nodes.label: Turner or machinist
nodes.note: Shape metal on lathes.

nodes.label: CNC machine operator
nodes.note: Run computer-controlled machines.

nodes.label: Auto mechanic
nodes.note: Repair cars and bikes.

nodes.label: AC and refrigeration technician
nodes.note: Install and fix coolers and ACs.

nodes.label: Plumber
nodes.note: Fit pipes and fix leaks.

nodes.label: Solar installer
nodes.note: Put solar panels on roofs.

nodes.label: Mobile phone technician
nodes.note: Repair phones and gadgets.

nodes.label: Carpenter
nodes.note: Make and fix wooden furniture.

nodes.label: Tailor or fashion technician
nodes.note: Stitch clothes and designs.

nodes.label: Computer operator (COPA)
nodes.note: Do office computer work.

nodes.label: Site supervisor
nodes.note: Watch over a building site.

nodes.label: Draughtsman
nodes.note: Draw plans for buildings and machines.

nodes.label: Quality inspector
nodes.note: Check that products are made well.

nodes.label: Laboratory technician
nodes.note: Run tests in a lab.

nodes.label: Diploma pharmacist
nodes.note: Work in a pharmacy after a diploma in pharmacy.
